description: This Java class 'ChangeLogLevelResponse' represents a response to a 'ChangeLogLevel' command within a DevOps context. It contains fields and methods to create instances from JSON, access response details such as success status, and override standard object methods. It is part of the package handling signals/commands for devops in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ChangeLogLevelResponse
classes.description: A response object for handling the reply of a ChangeLogLevel command, encapsulating success status, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ChangeLogLevelResponse with specified service name, instance, success status, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the ChangeLogLevelResponse from a JSON string or JSON object, given headers.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Returns whether the change log level operation was successful.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ChangeLogLevelResponse with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the JSON payload representing the success status into a JSON object builder.
